questions.question: Which language should the web application use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed React application with shared API contracts.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: JavaScript application without compile-time type checking.

questions.rationale: TypeScript is preferred in the supplied brief and helps keep financial UI/API contracts explicit.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and build tool should be used?

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify another frontend framework or build tool.

questions.rationale: The brief explicitly prefers React, TypeScript, and Vite.

questions.question: Which user-facing workflows should the frontend include, and which must remain sandbox-only until real providers and jurisdictional approvals are available?
questions.recommendedChoice: UTC-branded account dashboard, OTP sign-in, portfolio and order views, activity and compliance status; all trading, deposits, and withdrawals remain simulated or disabled until providers and legal/compliance approval are configured.
questions.answer: UTC-branded account dashboard, OTP sign-in, portfolio and order views, activity and compliance status; all trading, deposits, and withdrawals remain simulated or disabled until providers and legal/compliance approval are configured.
questions.rationale: The supplied brief requires a polished trading experience but explicitly prohibits enabling real execution or money movement before provider and jurisdiction-specific review.

questions.question: Which language should the application API use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed Cloudflare Workers services and validated API contracts.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: JavaScript Workers service without compile-time type checking.

questions.rationale: The brief prefers Workers/Hono and TypeScript for the backend.

questions.question: Which backend framework and runtime should be used?

options.label: Cloudflare Workers with Hono
options.description: Cloudflare-native HTTP API using Hono routing.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify another backend framework or runtime.

questions.rationale: This is the Cloudflare-native backend requested in the brief.

questions.question: Which API, security, ledger, and compliance capabilities should be included, and what must be explicitly excluded until production providers and review are available?
questions.recommendedChoice: OTP authentication, RBAC, provider interfaces, immutable double-entry ledger, idempotent sandbox order/payment flows, audit trail, KYC/compliance integration boundaries, and comprehensive tests. No live broker execution, deposits, or withdrawals without configured providers, verified credentials, and jurisdiction-specific legal/compliance approval.
questions.answer: OTP authentication, RBAC, provider interfaces, immutable double-entry ledger, idempotent sandbox order/payment flows, audit trail, KYC/compliance integration boundaries, and comprehensive tests. No live broker execution, deposits, or withdrawals without configured providers, verified credentials, and jurisdiction-specific legal/compliance approval.
questions.rationale: This records the brief's backend requirements while preserving a hard sandbox/production boundary.

questions.question: Which data stores should support the platform?

options.label: D1
options.description: Transactional relational data for users, orders, ledger entries, and audit records.

options.label: KV
options.description: Short-lived OTP, rate-limit, and cache state; not the source of truth for balances.

options.label: Queues
options.description: Asynchronous sandbox workflows and provider event processing.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Cloudflare R2-compatible object storage for compliance documents or evidence only if approved and required.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Choose only when the app needs no persistence, queue, cache, or object storage.

questions.rationale: A double-entry ledger requires durable relational transactions; OTP/rate limiting and async workflows need ephemeral state and a queue. KYC may involve documents, so object storage is included behind retention, access, encryption, and legal-review gates. Cloudflare products map to D1, Workers KV, Queues, and R2.

questions.question: Should users sign in to access application API features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users authenticate before accessing account and API features.

options.label: No
options.description: The application API does not require user sign-in.

questions.rationale: The brief requires OTP authentication and role-based access control. Identity-provider selection remains an implementation/provider decision and is not an Azure credential choice.
